title: Sup and Lipschitz bounds for convolution with a bounded Lipschitz kernel (step A1(ii), T1)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, all ρ, F : ℝⁿ → ℝ, every real A and every K ∈ ℝ≥0 such that |ρ(x)| ≤ A for all x, ρ is K-Lipschitz and F is Lebesgue integrable on ℝⁿ, the convolution (ρ⋆F)(x) := convolution ρ F (lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x = ∫ ρ(t)F(x − t) dt satisfies, for all x, y ∈ ℝⁿ: |(ρ⋆F)(x)| ≤ A·∫|F| and |(ρ⋆F)(x) − (ρ⋆F)(y)| ≤ K·‖x − y‖·∫|F|.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ρ F : Rn n → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), (∀ x, |ρ x| ≤ A) → LipschitzWith K ρ → Integrable F volume → ∀ x y : Rn n, |convolution ρ F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x| ≤ A * (∫ t, |F t|) ∧ |convolution ρ F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x - convolution ρ F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ * (∫ t, |F t|)
